Elaine Park: Quick sync — post-launch microcycle decision. Do we freeze new enhancements for one week and only ship hotpatches, or let small experiments through?
Mohit Rao: leaning freeze. keep focus on stability + customer unblock.
Samir Gupta: +1 freeze unless it's low-risk perf tweak. we saw a p95 bump yesterday (1.9s -> 2.1s) for /generate on some tails.
Ryan Li: what does CS say on impact?
Nina (CS): Two paying customers reported embedded instability (requests error 500) — both blocked on prod flows. one has a support SLA.
Elaine Park: ok that's leaning toward hotpatch. proposal: 48h triage window, then 5-day mini-iteration for prioritized fixes. any objections?
Ann (Design): if we freeze, can we still ship small UX polish that doesn't touch inference path?
Samir Gupta: yes if it only touches frontend and has a short A/B flag. backend changes that touch model routing need freeze.
Mohit Rao: propose rubric — if a bug meets hotpatch criteria we cut a patch branch and prioritize; otherwise it goes to the mini-iteration backlog.
deploy-bot: [CI] build 1766.3333 succeeded — staging deployed to canary. :rocket:
Elaine Park: sharing triage rubric (quick):
```
Triage rubric v1.0
- Hotpatch if: any of the following true
  * Customer-blocking (>=1 enterprise SLA customer)
  * Error rate delta > 0.5% absolute or 3x relative for a core route
  * Latency regression p95 > 5% vs baseline for /generate or /embed
  * Repro rate > 10% across requests
- Otherwise: schedule into next mini-iteration bucket (P1/P2)
- Exceptions: security and data-exfiltration always hotpatch
```
Ryan Li: looks reasonable. we need owners for the 48h triage. Samir + Mohit?
Samir Gupta: I can take model/regression side. will run a short run of the failing workload and pin down kernel/quant path.
Mohit Rao: I'll own routing/caching investigations.
Nina (CS): I'll field customers and escalate if anything new shows up.
Ann (Design): I'll audit any small polish PRs to ensure they can land safely.
Elaine Park: milestone plan: 
- 0-48h: triage + classify (owners above)
- 48h-72h: cut hotpatch branch if needed, QA smoke, canary rollout
- Day 4-9: mini-iteration: ship P1 fixes + 1 low-risk enhancement slot
- Day 10: retrospective + re-open feature lanes
Mohit Rao: add an explicit rollback window in the canary plan (30m).
Samir Gupta: will prepare perf harness + regression test; sharing quick command: `./tools/run_perf --workload postlaunch_tail --runs 50`
Elaine Park: concrete asks for triage thread: share failing traces, customer repro steps, and any model variant toggles used. keep updates short.
Nina (CS): shared two repros in the support ticket #C-9812 and #C-9819. pinged customers for logs.
Ryan Li: also add cost impact column for each bug (tokens lost / revenue risk) — helps prioritization.
Ann (Design): small note — if we hold polish, customers may request UI tweaks; we should keep a dedicated low-effort UX slot in the mini-iteration.
Elaine Park: agreed. final decision: freeze new backend enhancements for one week; run 48h triage -> hotpatch if rubric matches -> 5-day mini-iteration for P1/P2 backlog. owners: Samir, Mohit, Nina.
Mohit Rao: I'll kick off a triage doc and set the 1:30pm sync for 48h mark.
Samir Gupta: starting perf runs now, will drop notes in this thread.
deploy-bot: [Canary] rollout queued at 1766663380 — awaiting approvals.
Elaine Park: thanks everyone. keep updates here only (short bullets). :thumbsup:
